newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates end up amid market operation.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates end up amid market operation.

text.p: Pakistani money rates closed up on Wednesday amid an open market operation (OMO) by the State (central) Bank of Pakistan and dealers said the market was likely to open at similar levels on Thursday.
"Overnight trade was conducted at 20 percent and the market showed signs of closing short," a dealer at KASB & Co said, adding that three-day funds were also offered at 20 percent.
In the OMO, cut-offs for five-month repurchase contracts and outright sale of short-term federal bonds were steady at 16.50 percent, the same as in the previous auction, the dealer said.
